title: Accessible sign-up form — blinded jury rubric

criteria.question: Is every input programmatically associated with a visible label (not placeholder-as-label)?

anchors.3: labels present but association is visual only

criteria.question: Are errors communicated as text (not colour alone) and announced to assistive technology?

anchors.3: text error but no live region

criteria.question: Can the form be completed with the keyboard alone, with visible focus and focus moved to the first invalid field?

anchors.3: completable but focus is not managed on error

criteria.question: Do text and interactive states meet WCAG AA contrast at rest and on focus/hover?

anchors.3: passes at rest, fails on a state
anchors.5: passes AA at rest and in every state

criteria.question: Are validation messages, field styling and button treatment consistent across the form?

slopChecklist: placeholder used as the only label
focus outline removed with no replacement
generic 'Invalid input' with no field context

procedure.blinding: identities stripped, arms unlabelled, order randomised per rater
